statement: No S- action while an episode is open or intervening, or within cooldown_ms after it closes, unless two distinct circle members approve.
title: Open-episode lock

statement: An S- action needs a WebAuthn assertion from a passkey registered to a trusted-circle member. A valid Alexa access token alone never suffices: it identifies the household, not the speaker.
title: Proof origin

statement: The assertion challenge must equal the action hash SHA-256('hw-action-v1' || 0x00 || JCS({tool, args, household, episode_version, nonce, exp})). Any mismatch blocks.
title: Action binding

statement: Each challenge nonce is consumed by a conditional write before the action runs; a second use blocks. The passkey signature counter must increase.
title: Single use

statement: Phone numbers used to verify or to call come only from verified trusted-circle and trusted-vendor entries or the curated directory, never from tool arguments or conversation text.
title: Number provenance

statement: A vendor cannot be added within 24 hours of a visit or consultation that claimed a matching organization name (case-folded, whitespace-normalized).
title: Vendor cooling-off

statement: Changing the trusted circle needs proof from an existing member other than the person being added or removed, and every member is notified.
title: Circle changes

statement: A pause lasts at most 24 hours, expires on its own and cannot start or be extended while an episode is open.
title: Bounded pause

statement: Every S- action is first applied in a counterfactual branch of the household graph. If it would close an open episode or remove an evidence source, two distinct circle members must approve.
title: Simulated effect

statement: raise_concern is limited to 6 per hour per household and call_trusted_contact to 3 per episode. A CUSUM on alert volume demotes automatic escalation to notify-only.
title: Safety-raising rate limits

statement: If the broker, ledger or nonce store is unavailable, every S- tool returns BLOCKED while S+ tools keep working.
title: Fail closed only downward

statement: Evidence leaves the trusted circle only with proof and the elder's recorded consent in the consent ledger.
title: Evidence egress
